name: arxiv_search
description: Search academic papers on arXiv. Returns titles, authors, abstracts, and links.

manual.overview: Use arxiv_search to find academic and scientific papers. Returns titles, authors, abstracts, and PDF links. Essential for staying current on AI, physics, math, and computer science research.

examples.description: Search for papers on a topic
Find recent papers by an author

tips: Use 'au:' prefix to search by author name.
Use 'cat:' prefix to limit to a specific arXiv category (e.g. cs.AI, cs.CL, math.ST).
Read the abstract first before requesting the full paper.
For comprehensive literature reviews, set max_results to 10-20.
edge_cases: The arXiv API has rate limits — avoid making many rapid queries.
Results are in Atom XML format, which may need parsing.
Very recent papers (today) may not be indexed yet.
